decision: Exclude the unreferenced graphics register and icon definitions from the selected core build and retain them under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file contains video register, graphics icon and long conditional-jump definitions.
No reference to pcgequ.inc appears in retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include source trees or the frozen selected dependency inventory.
limitations: The exclusion applies to the selected three-component build only; other DOS graphics components may use this file.
